BAJAJ-AUTO.d: Bajaj Auto Limited manufactures motorcycles, commercial vehicles, and electric two-wheelers for domestic and international markets. It is among the world's largest exporters of motorcycles.

BAJAJFINSV.d: Bajaj Finserv Limited operates as a holding company offering financial services through its subsidiaries, spanning life and general insurance, lending, and wealth advisory. It serves retail and corporate customers across India.

BAJAJHFL.d: Bajaj Housing Finance Limited provides home loans, property loans, and developer financing. It serves retail home buyers and real estate developers across India.

BAJAJHLDNG.d: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited operates as a core investment company holding significant equity stakes in Bajaj Auto and other Bajaj group firms. It generates revenue primarily through dividend income and interest from its financial investments.

BAJFINANCE.d: Bajaj Finance offers consumer durable loans, personal loans, SME financing, and wealth management services. It is one of India's largest non-banking financial companies.

BALKRISIND.d: Balkrishna Industries manufactures off-highway tires for agricultural, industrial, and construction vehicles. It exports the majority of its products to global markets and equipment manufacturers.

BANDHANBNK.d: Bandhan Bank Limited provides retail banking services with a primary focus on microfinance and unbanked rural markets across India. It offers savings accounts, microloans, and general banking products to individuals and small businesses.

BANKBARODA.d: Bank of Baroda is a state-owned public sector bank offering retail, corporate, and international banking services to individual and institutional customers. It operates a vast domestic and global branch network.

BANKINDIA.d: Bank of India is a public sector bank offering retail, corporate, and international banking services. It serves individuals, government entities, and corporate clients globally.

BBOX.d: Black Box designs, deploys, and manages IT infrastructure and network communication systems for enterprise clients globally. It operates as a subsidiary of Ruia Group company AGC Networks.

BDL.d: Bharat Dynamics Limited manufactures guided missiles and allied defense equipment. It is a state-owned enterprise that supplies products primarily to the Indian Armed Forces.

BEL.d: Bharat Electronics Limited manufactures electronic equipment and systems for the defense sector, including radar, communication, and electronic warfare systems. It is a state-owned enterprise serving the Indian armed forces.

BEML.d: BEML Limited manufactures heavy equipment for mining, construction, defense, and rail transport. It is a state-owned enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India.

BERGEPAINT.d: Berger Paints India manufactures and distributes decorative and industrial coatings, wood finishes, and paints. It is one of India's largest paint companies.

BHARATFORG.d: The company manufactures and sells forged and machined metal components for automotive and industrial sectors worldwide. It is one of the largest metal forging companies globally.

BHARTIARTL.d: Bharti Airtel provides mobile telephony, broadband, and enterprise telecommunication services across South Asia and Africa. It is one of India's largest private telecommunications service providers.

BHARTIHEXA.d: The company provides cellular and fixed-line telecommunication services in specific telecom circles in India. It is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Limited.

BHEL.d: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited manufactures power plant equipment, turbines, and industrial systems. It is a state-owned engineering enterprise controlled by the Government of India.

BIKAJI.d: Bikaji Foods International Limited manufactures and sells ethnic snacks, sweets, and packaged food products. Its customers include retail consumers across India and international export markets.

BIOCON.d: Biocon Limited manufactures generic active pharmaceutical ingredients and complex biologics, focusing on biosimilars and insulin. It operates through specialized research and manufacturing subsidiaries.

BLUESTARCO.d: Blue Star Limited manufactures and markets cooling products, including air conditioners, commercial refrigeration equipment, and air purification systems. It also provides engineering services for central air conditioning and ventilation projects.

BOSCHLTD.d: Bosch Limited manufactures automotive components, including fuel injection systems and power tools. It is a subsidiary of the global German engineering firm Robert Bosch GmbH.

BPCL.d: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited is a state-owned oil refining and marketing company that produces fuels, lubricants, and petrochemicals. Its end markets include retail consumers, industrial clients, and aviation sectors.

BRIGADE.d: Brigade Enterprises Limited develops residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality real estate projects, primarily across South India.

BRITANNIA.d: Britannia Industries manufactures and sells packaged foods, including biscuits, bread, cakes, and dairy products. It serves retail consumers primarily in India and international markets.

BSE.d: BSE Limited operates a stock exchange providing platforms for trading equity, debt, and derivatives. It is Asia's oldest stock exchange and a major market infrastructure institution in India.
